description.raw: '''Passive:''' Dealing damage with ''[[File:Shen Twilight Assault.png|20xpx|border|link=Shen#Twilight Assault|An icon for Shen's ability Twilight Assault]] [[Shen#Twilight Assault|Twilight Assault]]'' or ''Shadow Dash'' restores [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] 30 / 40 / 50 (based on level) energy.
description.text: Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or Shadow Dash restores  30 / 40 / 50 (based on level) energy.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Shen''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] and [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] he passes through and [[File:Taunt icon.png|20px|link=Taunt|An icon representing the keyword Taunt]] [[:Taunt|taunting]] them for 1.5 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Shen dashes to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemy champions and monsters he passes through and taunting them for 1.5 seconds.

description3.raw: ''[[File:Shen Twilight Assault.png|20xpx|border|link=Shen#Twilight Assault|An icon for Shen's ability Twilight Assault]] [[Shen#Twilight Assault|Twilight Assault]] and [[File:Shen Spirit's Refuge.png|20xpx|border|link=Shen#Spirit's Refuge|An icon for Shen's ability Spirit's Refuge]] [[Shen#Spirit's Refuge|Spirit's Refuge]] can be cast during the dash.''
description3.text: Twilight Assault and Spirit's Refuge can be cast during the dash.

leveling2.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 (+ 11% '''bonus''' health)

notes.raw: * Casting [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] during ''Shadow Dash'' will end the dash prematurely, but the end-of-dash collision check will hit enemies at the [[blink|blink's]] location still. ** This still cannot affect the same enemy more than once. * The energy restore from ''Shadow Dash'' may only occur once.
notes.text:
Casting Flash during Shadow Dash will end the dash prematurely, but the end-of-dash collision check will hit enemies at the blink's location still.
* This still cannot affect the same enemy more than once.
The energy restore from Shadow Dash may only occur once.
